theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_db_withDensity_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (M B B' : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (c K : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ B' → K ≠ ∞ → μ = (μHE[n].restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x)) → (∀ x ∈ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ≤ c + K * g x) → μ B ≤ c * μHE[n] (M ∩ B) + K * ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B', g x ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
